title: Independent temporal localization of controlled selfed-seed viability sensitivity under fixed pollen background

frozen_primary.D: average A-first minus I-first terminal occupancy with 4 reproductive settings, 2 prehistory environments, 2 nested repeats, 2 future visitor environments, and original 7 log-budget weights
frozen_primary.interpretation: difference in controlled early-only versus late-only seed-viability timing influence on demographic K moderation of assigned expression-order occupancy, at B48
frozen_primary.support: abs(mean)>=0.005 and 95% paired history percentile interval excludes 0

descriptive.note: All are descriptive; no promotion based on observed significance; timing location does not identify genealogical mediation.

fail_closed_gates: Read source genomes and complete pedigrees from each of 64 new independent complete source shards with hashes
Reject old visitor IDs and any premature peek or alternate stochastic seeds
At each postshock update, only selfed viable seed multipliers change according to registered gate/time
Full and early have identical initial seed viability; baseline and late share identical t0 reproductive ledger
Every K arm begins from same at-most-eight complete diploid genomes with identical B48
Require 64 history shards, 2048 sources and 229376 SHA-checked futures before any analysis
All source-extinct and late-ineligible realized paths stay in the cohort
Paired history-cluster bootstrap resamples 64 independent visitor histories, not 229376 futures
Original 2026-10-09 confirmed demographic K result and prior inconclusive tests are preserved verbatim
limitation: A stage-specific seed gate can act only while population survives; this is a valid intervention-to-occupancy total effect but not a survival-conditioned mediator.
The outcome is local terminal occupancy after 80 updates, not lifetime fitness.
Transient assigned expression order is not natural genetic mutation arrival order.
This synthetic K/B parameter experiment is not calibrated to observed island size, pollen competition or extinction.
Early and late intervention windows have equal calendar duration, not equal realized survival-time exposure.
